item.title: NSA hands over remaining 130 St Mary’s Catholic School pupils, teachers to Gov Bago
item.description: The National Security Adviser, NSA, Mallam Nuhu Ribadu, has officially handed over the remaining 130 kidnapped students and teachers of St Mary’s Catholic School to Niger state Governor Mohammed Umar Bago. Recall on 8 December, 2025, the Office of the NSA officially handed over a total of 100 kidnapped students to the Niger State government. item.title: ABU revives dual degree scheme with China’s CSU to boost tech education
item.description: The Ahmadu Bello University (ABU) Zaria has moved to revive and expand its double degree partnership with a Chinese university poised to deepen technology education in Nigeria. Auwalu Umar, ABU’s director of public affairs, stated on Sunday that the partnership is with the Central South University (CSU) China. item.title: New ambassadors to resume at their respective posts in 2026 – Federal Govt

item.title: I nominated Osinbajo as Buhari’s VP after consulting Tinubu — Bisi Akande
item.description: A founding member of the All Progressives Congress, APC, and former Governor of Osun State, Bisi Akande, has disclosed that he was instrumental in the emergence of Yemi Osinbajo as Vice President. Akande said he nominated Osinbajo for the position after consulting with President Bola Tinubu in 2011.
